column3: Close to the Hebrew; the MT phrase “daughter of Ashurim” (or “boxwood”) is rendered “The company of Ashurites,” and “Kittim” is rendered “Cyprus.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Lud and Put” are rendered “Lydia, and Libya.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV keeps the MT “Aram” (“Syria”; many manuscripts read “Edom”). The precious stones are of uncertain identity.
Close to the Hebrew; the uncertain word pannag is rendered “millet.”
The MT reads “Vedan and Javan from Uzal”; the meaning is uncertain. NKJV renders “Dan and Javan… traversing back and forth.”
